scientific_integrity: Analytical proof and exact-rational supporting program included; external independent mathematical validation not performed. General periodic-word methods and preexisting LLR attractors are credited.
scientific_limitations: Strict hyperbolically attracting prime-three orbits in the two-saddle region only. The golden-ratio value is sharp only for nonemptiness of the explicitly constructed edge strip, not for global period-three feasibility. No claim about chaotic attractor coexistence, other periods, or boundary orbits. Priority uncertainty from general 2016 review and possible unindexed studies.
title: Attracting three-cycle chirality at the two-saddle border-collision boundary
